item.title: Longtime Trump critic reveals why she thinks his Iran actions are wrong, warns it's a 'much bigger war'
item.summary: The U.S. strikes in Iran prompted fierce Democrat-led criticism, including from Rep. Jayapal, who argued Trump violated congressional authorities under the U.S. Constitution.

item.title: King Charles to address 'increasing pressures of conflict' in speech as Trump criticizes British PM on Iran
item.summary: King Charles will deliver a Commonwealth Day message about "pressures of conflict" following President Trump's criticism of the U.K.'s refusal to join the strikes against Iran.

item.title: South Carolina pastor describes evacuating members from Middle East after war broke out during Israel trip
item.summary: Dozens of members of Calvary Chapel Summerville traveled to Israel to explore the Holy Land, but were stranded after Operation Epic Fury launched just hours before their flight home.

item.title: Trump says US, Israel shattered Iranian military capabilities, presses leaders to surrender: 'Cry uncle'
item.summary: President Donald Trump reports joint strikes have destroyed 44 Iranian ships and "every plane," calling for Iran to surrender as gas price concerns mount at home.

item.title: Trump tells Starmer aircraft carriers no longer needed in Mideast, accuses him of joining war US 'already won'
item.summary: President Trump criticized British Prime Minister Keir Starmer on Saturday over delays in sending an aircraft carrier to the Middle East.

item.title: NYC Mayor Mamdani’s wife liked social media post calling Oct 7 sexual violence investigation a ‘hoax’: report
item.summary: NYC Mayor Zohran Mamdani's wife is facing scrutiny after allegedly liking posts about the Oct. 7 Hamas attack, including one dismissing an investigation into sexual violence as a "hoax."

item.title: Russian missile strike kills 10 in Ukraine as Trump says 'hatred' between countries complicating peace deal
item.summary: Russian missile strike kills at least 10 people, including 2 children, in Kharkiv residential building as Ukraine faces massive overnight assault.

item.title: Kyle Schwarber leads Team USA to 9-1 World Baseball Classic win over Britain
item.summary: Team USA steamrolled Britain 9-1 in the World Baseball Classic Saturday night, improving to 2-0 in Pool B at Houston.

item.title: Exiled Iranian crown prince says regime is 'crumbling' after killing of Khamenei, other leaders
item.summary: Exiled Iranian Crown Prince Reza Pahlavi declares the Islamic Republic is "crumbling" following the death of Supreme Leader Ali Khamenei.

item.title: Rare, historic US documents traveling country on 'Freedom Plane' ahead of America's 250th anniversary
item.summary: The National Archives has launched a nationwide tour transporting rare founding-era documents to cities across the United States ahead of America’s 250th anniversary.
